This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies, utilizing cards that generate tokens and pump up your creatures. The key idea is to overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of creatures that can quickly take control of the battlefield. The deck also includes some enchantments and spells to provide additional support and protection for your creatures. By utilizing the Selesnya colors, this deck combines the strength of green creatures with the resilience and unity of white spells, creating a well-rounded aggro deck that can quickly close out games.

The deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with low-cost creatures and spells that generate additional tokens or provide buffs to existing creatures. By utilizing cards like Wedding Announcement, The Restoration of Eiganjo, and Teachings of the Kirin, the deck can overwhelm opponents with a wide array of creatures. Cards like Rite of Harmony and Hallowed Haunting help maintain card advantage and generate additional resources. Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr and Generous Visitor provide additional support and synergy within the deck. With a mix of creature generation and support spells, the deck aims to outpace opponents and win through aggression.

The mana base is set up to ensure consistency and smooth gameplay, allowing for a calculated and methodical approach to victory.
